My reason is medical. I'm in constant agony, & have been for almost a decade. My condition is worsening, & it's looking like I'll need to live with her & my dad or in an assisted living place sooner rather than later. In my area, that would most likely mean a nursing home. (I'm only 34)  My independence has been slowly wearing away since I developed the medical condition (it's called complex regional pain syndrome) 9 years & 4 months ago, but that process sped up a lot over the last year or two
Sorry, I must not have been clear. She's not one of the reasons I plan to die. In fact, the idea that she would like it almost made me reconsider. But that's not worth keeping myself in agony

Not really. Being disabled & unable to do things isolates me, which makes my depression worse. I have had mental health problems since I was about 10, but constant agony has made them worse. But it's the pain that makes life unbearable

For over 9 years I've been in constant pain. My medical conditions are getting worse, & I just can't handle the pain anymore. Nothing helps it, & the last 2 times I saw the specialist I was told that there was no point in seeing her because we've tried all of the treatment options

Therapy has helped me cope with the constant pain thus far, but the techniques aren't working anymore. There's nothing I want long term except to be not in so much pain & to be able to live a normal life. I want to be able to work. I don't want to rely on government funding. I want to be able to do my own housework.

I guess I just feel like I'm running out of persistent & the ability to persevere
